body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves the detail page experience by standardizing field label i18n resolution (via `useSafeFieldLabel`) and making related list auto-generated columns render values using type-aware cell renderers, while also filling gaps in the `detail.*` locale packs.

**Changes:**
- Thread `objectName` through detail components and resolve field labels via `useSafeFieldLabel` (DetailSection, HeaderHighlight, RelatedList).
- Enhance RelatedList auto-generated columns with `getCellRenderer` and fix sortable headers to use `effectiveColumns`.
- Add missing `detail.*` translation keys to both `en.ts` and `zh.ts`, and update the console fallback “Details” section title to use i18n.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/SectionGroup.tsx | Adds `objectName` prop and forwards it to `DetailSection` for i18n label resolution. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx | Adds `objectName`, resolves column headers via `useSafeFieldLabel`, adds type-aware `cell` renderers for auto-generated columns, and fixes sortable header source. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx | Adds `objectName` and resolves highlight field labels via `useSafeFieldLabel`. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Threads `schema.objectName` into child components; passes child object name into related lists for correct label resolution. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Resolves field labels via `useSafeFieldLabel` using threaded `objectName`. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts | Adds missing `detail.*` keys referenced by `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts | Adds missing `detail.*` keys referenced by `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Uses i18n for fallback section title (“Details”). |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the i18n and related list rendering work as completed. |
</details>

`useObjectTranslation()` is used directly here, but several console tests render `RecordDetailView` without an `I18nProvider`. That can throw at runtime (similar to why `useDetailTranslation` exists as a safe wrapper). Consider switching to `useDetailTranslation()` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (already a dependency in this file) or introducing a local safe translation wrapper so this component remains renderable in non-i18n contexts.
